description: The structural record of the three rigged models the game instantiates at run time. tools/model_library.py --check compares every registered model against it on every run; a difference fails the check and the manifest is updated on purpose, by tools/model_library.py --update-manifest, so the change shows up in review.
scope: Runtime characters only. art/character_rigging/ (Blender working files and the unrigged Q source), scenes/dev/animation_retarget_test/ (a development retarget asset) and art/character_rig_audit/*_rig_audit.json (Blender-side audits of other stages) are deliberately not covered: they are different stages of the same character, and mixing them is how a manifest starts describing a file nobody ships.
measured_from: The .glb files as committed, read by tools/model_library.py. Not the Blender sources, not the rig audits.

models.note: The first protagonist model; since PR #118 a seated classroom student (scenes/locations/classroom/classroom.tscn, Actors/SeatedStudent) with no controller or interaction. One armature (RIG_Protagonist_Blockout) whose 16 deform bones are the skin's joints, 78 mesh nodes all bound to that skin, 22 materials, and no embedded animation: the seven clips in scripts/actors/character_animation.gd are composed onto this rig's rest pose at run time.

The second rigged character. Q_Humanoid_Skeleton carries 16 joints with the same names and parentage as the protagonist's rig, which is what lets one set of semantic clips bind to both; 7 mesh nodes and 15 primitives, 14 materials, no embedded animation. This is the runtime asset: art/character_rigging/q/q_unrigged_source.glb and art/character_rig_audit/q_rig_audit.json describe the unrigged stage, and scenes/dev/animation_retarget_test/q_rigged.glb is a development retarget asset — none of those are what the game loads.

The player character since PR #118. One armature (Protagonist_Armature) whose 60 bones are the skin's joints (root, four IK targets, pelvis, four spine/chest bones, clavicles, arms, hands with 15 finger joints each, neck, head, eyes, legs and toes), 9 mesh nodes all bound to that skin (the head carries 9 blend shapes), 12 materials, and five embedded animations that the game does not play (the imported AnimationPlayer has no autoplay): the seven clips in scripts/actors/character_animation.gd are composed onto this rig's rest pose at run time, and 15 of the 60 joints are keyed by them.
